steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟 Slowly 官方網站（中文頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the official Slowly website (Chinese page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 Slowly App。
steps.en: Download the Slowly app as the page directs.

steps.zh-TW: 在 App 內建立個人檔案，開始寫信給筆友。
steps.en: Create your profile in the app and start writing to pen pals.

intro.zh-TW: Slowly 是跨國筆友 App：寫信給世界各地的人，距離越遠，信件越晚送達。
intro.en: Slowly is a pen pal app: write letters to people around the world; the farther away they are, the longer a letter takes to arrive.

description.zh-TW: Slowly 是一款跨國筆友 App，讓你寫信給世界各地的人，對方離得越遠，信件越晚送達。這個連結指向 Slowly 官方網站的中文頁，不含個人推薦碼，所以不需要輸入或貼上任何代碼：點擊「立即註冊」開啟後，依頁面指示下載 App，再於 App 內建立個人檔案，就能開始寫信給筆友。下載前，請先確認頁面網域屬於 slowly.app。
description.en: Slowly is a pen pal app where you write letters to people around the world, and the farther away the recipient is, the longer a letter takes to arrive. The link on this page leads to the official Slowly website (Chinese page) and carries no personal referral code, so there is nothing to type or paste. Select “Sign up”, download the app as the page directs, then create your profile in the app and start writing to pen pals. Before downloading, check that the page you land on belongs to slowly.app.

notes.zh-TW: 這是官方網站的連結，不含個人推薦碼或追蹤參數，所以不是推薦連結。分享文案也沒有說明優惠內容。
notes.en: This is a link to the official website with no personal referral code or tracking parameters, so it is not a referral link. The share text describes no offer either.
